interactions.drag: FPS dragged from default top-left to bottom-right; x/y distances snap to 0; toolbar moves to top.
interactions.scale: Button + and wheel over selected FPS both change scale to 1.1; rendered glyphs and saved scale agree.
interactions.anchors: A changes RIGHT/BOTTOM to LEFT/TOP while preserving visible position.
interactions.reset: R restores selected FPS default placement/scale; Home resets profile 2 layout while profile 1 remains RIGHT/BOTTOM at scale 1.1.
interactions.keyboard: Right arrow moves profile 2 FPS from x=8 to x=9; Tab selects Coordinates and toolbar moves below it.
interactions.names: N selects full existing name; press_key injection on Russian layout replaces it with Cyrillic ф; Enter saves, restart retains it. Unicode type_text injection was ignored by LWJGL and is not counted as successful typing.
interactions.profiles: Keys 1/2 switch independent placements/scales/flags; profile 2 FPS OFF leaves profile 1 ON.
interactions.importExport: O exports profile 1; copied fixture imports through I into profile 2 only; all profile 0 keys unchanged and all imported profile 1 keys equal export.
interactions.navigation: Esc returns to modules with Edit layout focused; Tab reaches Done then Search. Empty search results retain both footer buttons without overlap.
interactions.worldHud: After editor closes, FPS renders at saved bottom-right corner; F1 and F3 each hide it and second press restores it.

resolutionMatrix.result: Selected FPS, complete focus outline and all toolbar controls visible; saved RIGHT/BOTTOM 0/0, scale 1.1 retained.
